I purchased this Pro Tech Go Toolkit in order to change the battery on my 2018 MacBook Pro 15" Retina with Touch Bar. While I purchased the associated adhesive remover kit with the battery, I was concerned that a T3 might not be included as one reviewer said they didn't have one. I ended up not needing this toolkit except for the pry bar knife, as everything was already included in the battery kit. However the quality of the kit is great and I would highly recommend purchasing this and will use it for any other repairs on my devices in the future. I was able to complete my project with no issues and like having redundancies if any of the bits deform with use or for other tech projects around the house.

I received my pro tech go a couple of days ago and decided to finally change a macbook air's screen that I've been putting off because one of the hinge screws would not turn with the kit I got from microcenter. I've drilled that screw, used a dremel on it, tried the rubber band thing. It wouldn't budge. So I used a flathead from this kit into this ruined screw and to my surprise it started turning. With the smallest grip surface imaginable. I am so impressed at the quality of this kit, everything turns so smoothly, it's actually life changing.
